posts.title: System 2 Is Too Expensive for Your Banking App
posts.description: Nobody uses System 2 to check their bank account. I just finished Nicky Hayes's A Little History of Psychology . Near the end, she covers Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky's split between System 1 and System 2. System 1 is automatic and fast. posts.title: Europe Has Turned Innovation Into Paperwork
posts.description: I work in mobile banking in France. Regulation is part of my job. I don't want a banking system without it. But every rule costs time. Someone has to read it, interpret it, change the product and prove compliance. A big company hires another lawyer. A startup can lose months. The AI Act shows the problem. posts.title: Why Venice Is My Default for Almost Everything AI
posts.description: I pay for fewer AI services every month. Venice is replacing them one by one. I use it for almost anything AI related. After months of daily use I'm still a happy customer. One subscription, all the models # Every available model, open-weight and frontier, behind one API and one clean interface. Pick a model per task, move on. Hard reasoning problem? Frontier model. Prefer open-weight? Also there.
